decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Refusal

The proposed rear extension would add significantly to the existing rear extension that already exceeds the Council's residential extension guidelines, to the detriment of the character and the appearance of the original dwelling.  It would appear visually intrusive when seen from neighbouring premises and would detract from the open aspect to the rear of premises at the east side of Sunbury Road.  It is considered to be an over development of the property and is therefore contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development), H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is also not compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to dwellinghouse.
